meta.description: Benign open-redirect canary URLs. Each points at an RFC 2606-safe .invalid domain that VortexDAST controls no infrastructure for and never resolves — only the Location header or page body is inspected, nothing is fetched from the canary host.

canary_probes.description: Protocol-relative URL — bypasses a naive 'starts with http' allowlist
Leading backslash — some URL parsers normalise '\' to '/' before a same-host check runs
